# Rakesh Kumar Tripathi

> AGM – Product at Redcliffe Labs, India. 16+ years building AI-powered products across HealthTech, vision care and E-Commerce, HR Tech and EdTech. Website: https://thetripathi.com/

Also known as: Rakesh Tripathi, RKT, thetripathi.

## Current role

- AGM – Product, Redcliffe Labs (diagnostics, HealthTech), Noida, India. Promoted from Senior Product Manager in April 2026.
- Leads a team of 6 product managers across a portfolio of 35–40 products. Reports to the CEO and CMO.

## Career

- 2026 – now: AGM – Product, Redcliffe Labs
- 2024 – 2026: Senior Product Manager, Redcliffe Labs
- 2021 – 2024: Product Manager, Lenskart
- 2014 – 2021: Senior Product Manager, Youth4work
- 2012 – 2014: Product Manager, Youth4work
- 2010 – 2012: Product Designer, JAGbros Consultants

## Case studies

- [Redcliffe Labs: AI-powered diagnostics](https://thetripathi.com/work/redcliffe/): AI report summaries and recommendations (+30% test bookings), booking and payment flows, CRM, telephony (Exotel, Ozonetel), an in-house ATS and HRMS, in-app chat for VIP users (−35% support calls).
- [Lenskart: Tele-Optometrist](https://thetripathi.com/work/lenskart/): video eye consultations (78% fewer prescription errors, 95% accuracy), the Eye Power Bank app (75% adoption in 3 months), a store-locator and appointment rebuild (15K to 47K online appointments a month).
- [Youth4work: assessments and EdTech](https://thetripathi.com/work/youth4work/): an online assessment platform for 300+ corporate clients (10,000+ candidates a month), candidate matching and ranking, ATS/HRMS integrations, an EdTech platform for 500+ educators.
- [JAGbros Consultants: where it began](https://thetripathi.com/work/jagbros/): product design, user flows and visual hierarchy for client products.

## Skills

Product strategy and roadmaps; PRDs, epics and user stories; Agile / Scrum; metrics and KPIs; AI products; SQL, Google Analytics, Power BI; APIs and system integrations; telephony (Exotel, Ozonetel); payments (Razorpay, PayU); ATS / HRMS integrations; chatbot and ticketing flows; UI/UX (Figma, Adobe XD); leading product teams.
